values.en: For a plane curve $\gamma\colon(a,b)\to\mathbb{R}^{2}$ parametrized by arc length ($\lVert\gamma'\rVert\equiv 1$), the **signed curvature** is $k_{\gamma}=\langle T',\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}\rangle$ with $T:=\gamma'$ and $\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}=JT$, i.e. $k_{\gamma}(t)=\langle\gamma''(t),\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}(t)\rangle$. Since $\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}$ is unit, $k_{\gamma}$ is the (signed) coordinate of $T'$ in the normal direction, and $T'=\gamma''=k_{\gamma}\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}$. For a regular plane curve in a general parameter one has $k_{\gamma}=\det(\gamma',\gamma'')/\lVert\gamma'\rVert^{3}$ (the denominator is nonzero by regularity); there $T=\gamma'/\lVert\gamma'\rVert$. Reversing the orientation changes the sign of $k_{\gamma}$, and the non-negative curvature of the plane curve equals $|k_{\gamma}|$.
values.zh-CN: 对以弧长参数化的平面曲线 $\gamma\colon(a,b)\to\mathbb{R}^{2}$（$\lVert\gamma'\rVert\equiv 1$），**带符号曲率**定义为 $k_{\gamma}=\langle T',\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}\rangle$，其中 $T:=\gamma'$、$\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}=JT$，即 $k_{\gamma}(t)=\langle\gamma''(t),\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}(t)\rangle$。由于 $\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}$ 是单位向量，$k_{\gamma}$ 就是 $T'$ 在法向上的（带符号）坐标，且 $T'=\gamma''=k_{\gamma}\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}$。对一般参数下的正则平面曲线有 $k_{\gamma}=\det(\gamma',\gamma'')/\lVert\gamma'\rVert^{3}$（分母由正则性非零）；此时 $T=\gamma'/\lVert\gamma'\rVert$。反转定向会改变 $k_{\gamma}$ 的符号；平面曲线的非负曲率等于 $|k_{\gamma}|$。

values.en: Signed Curvature of a Plane Curve
values.zh-CN: 平面曲线的带符号曲率
